note: Paths are relative to the repo root. data/india/ holds registry + derived/tiny assets only; the large source archives live under Vippatti_India_Data/ and are the canonical copies.

datasets.provenance: National Wide Information Centre administrative boundaries

datasets.geographicCoverage: Andhra Pradesh — village boundaries (pilot state; NOT India-wide)
datasets.usageNote: Village level for AP only. Other states NOT yet downloaded — hierarchy must degrade honestly, not invent.
Population baseline ONLY — never current population; never current risk.

unavailableOfficialSources.name: NDEM / NRSC National Database for Emergency Management
unavailableOfficialSources.reason: Requires NRSC/ISRO authorized login for full GIS downloads. No open programmatic access.
unavailableOfficialSources.fallbackUsed: NONE — no third-party substitute was adopted in its place.
unavailableOfficialSources.handlingRule: Report as unavailable. Never scrape, never substitute silently.

unavailableOfficialSources.name: NRSC Bhuvan thematic hazard layers (flood inundation, landslide susceptibility, multi-hazard)
unavailableOfficialSources.reason: Per-layer manual selection/download; no documented open bulk API; terms per layer.
unavailableOfficialSources.handlingRule: If acquired manually, must be registered here with layer, date, license before use.

unavailableOfficialSources.name: IMD official warning polygons (district/taluk gridded)
unavailableOfficialSources.reason: CAP RSS gives alert text, severity, certainty and sometimes a polygon; gridded warning layers are portal-only.
unavailableOfficialSources.fallbackUsed: CAP RSS only — alerts retained WITH their CAP identifier and sender.
unavailableOfficialSources.handlingRule: Never synthesise a warning polygon that the CAP alert did not carry.

unavailableOfficialSources.name: Central Water Commission — live river gauge data
unavailableOfficialSources.reason: No documented open programmatic feed for live gauge readings found during source audit.
unavailableOfficialSources.handlingRule: River level / flood status must stay UNKNOWN rather than be estimated.

unavailableOfficialSources.name: Live road closures / traffic conditions
unavailableOfficialSources.reason: No official pan-India open feed identified in source audit.
unavailableOfficialSources.handlingRule: Route safety/traffic status must be reported as UNAVAILABLE, never assumed clear.
